content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Des Moines

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's full criteria to confirm you meet education and hours requirements before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend all sessions from your location in Des Moines or anywhere with internet access. Our instructors deliver comprehensive PMBOK® Guide coverage and exam-focused content across the full program.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35-hour course, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of education and project experience. Pay the PMI exam fee when you apply. Allow time for PMI's review and approval before scheduling your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study guides, to reinforce bootcamp content. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE at a test center or online. Sit for the four-hour, 200-question PMP exam when ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, you must earn 60 professional development units (PDUs) every three years to keep your certification active. Pursue continuing education through PMI-approved activities, training, or volunteer work in project management to meet renewal requirements.
